proposals.title: FAIL — /lebron-james-cards publishes three graded figures as 'recent sold comps' sourced to SportsCardsPro, with no sale count and a 42-day-old stamp, on the page that gained an Authenticity-Guarantee buy link yesterday. cos-2026-09-16-graded-ladder never reached this page.
evidence: Live 2026-09-21T12:11:42Z, served HTML, hand-authored, no ENGINE markers and no repaint script.
Page-level claim: 'prices below are recent sold comps (SportsCardInvestor / SportsCardsPro / Card Ladder, plus The Hobby Wire's +11.4% read on the raw Topps RC since Jul 27)'.

Graded figures with no sale count: '2003 Topps #221 PSA 10 $6,000-$7,200' (labelled 'Recent eBay range'), 'Chrome #111 PSA 10 ~$12,000', 'Chrome #111 PSA 9 ~$2,637'. Raw figures ~$512 and ~$2,460 same block.
The only attribution on the page is 'May 2026 auction printed $12,000 even' — a four-month-old single auction under the words 'recent sold comps'.
Stamp: prose 'Comps as of Aug 10, 2026' x2 plus 'as of Aug 10, 2026' in the table intro = 42 days. tools/audit-prices.mjs sets STALE_DAYS = 21.

Page carries NO data-prices-updated, so check 4 never runs; check 9 raises no-machine-stamp (inside the accepted 60-WARN baseline); check 6 stale-prose-stamp measures drift against the page's OWN newest date, which is also Aug 10, so drift is 0 and it stays silent. A page where every date is equally old is invisible to the freshness gate by construction.
Present-tense framing over 42-day-old data: hero 'his raw 2003 Topps rookie is up double digits'; stat grid '30-Day Move +24%' with no window stated (reads as Aug 22-Sep 21; is Jul 11-Aug 10).

Aggravating: 7d0f85f (2026-09-20 15:50Z) selected this page for the AG link on a live /api/comps median ask of $9,500 / 19 AG listings read that day. A measurement taken yesterday sits in the buy strip above a comp set stamped 42 days ago.

Secondary, same page, not filed separately: the post-signing move is published as +24% (hero chip, deep dive) and as +11.4% (warning block, Avoid list). Different windows, used interchangeably; only the smaller figure is attributed.
ruleBasis: cos-2026-09-16-graded-ladder (applied, HIGH): every graded figure with no dated sale behind it reads 'No verified sale'; SCP's grade ladder is partly modelled.
LANE-RULES Part B: a figure labelled 'sold' that is not a dated transaction; a dated claim past its ttl.

iw-2026-09-17-4 (awaiting-cos): the gate gap. FIFTH reproduction, and the first where the sold-claim is page-scoped rather than cell-scoped — which is precisely what that item's proposed prose-scoped check would catch. Recommend ruling it.
proposals.r6: Not a re-file. No proposal in the 145 covers lebron-james-cards.html. cos-2026-09-16-graded-ladder names /ethan-holliday-rookie-cards, /aiva-arquette-1st-bowman, /roy-watch-2026. iw-2026-09-17-1 is the board. audit-2026-09-07-1's 22-page list and 8-page watch list do not include this page — on Sep 7 its Aug 10 stamp was 28 days old and correctly under that item's 63-87 day bar. It has since crossed the 21-day line, as has /cameron-boozer-rookie-cards (also Aug 10, also no machine stamp, but its figures are individually dated and attributed, so it is reported as clear, not filed).
proposals.suggestedFix: Owner: the first publishing lane from a fresh clone. (a) Every graded tier reads either '(N dated sale)' with the date or 'No verified sale', per the Sep 16 ruling — the $6,000-$7,200 PSA 10 range and the ~$2,637 PSA 9 have nothing behind them today. (b) Drop 'recent sold comps' as a page-level basis claim or replace it with what the figures actually are. (c) Re-read or withdraw the Aug 10 figures and ADD data-prices-updated so the sweep owns the page from then on. (d) State the +24% window or reconcile it with the attributed +11.4%. Do NOT roll the stamp without re-reading the prices — that is what audit-2026-09-07-1's Sep 7 attempt got wrong.

1. 'Marks are the engine's nightly reads from verified eBay asking prices - asks, not solds - dated above and never hand-typed; set indices are sold comps only, re-marked weekly.'
2. 'Prices on this page are the engine's nightly reads from verified eBay asking prices (asks, not solds) and the set indices' weekly sold-comp re-marks, dated on the page.'

STATE 2026-09-18 evening, in its own words: 'the Markets panel subheader called all seven indices sold-only while BCB26 and BOW26 are ask-basis - real claims defect, fixed this push (one string, outside the generated markers)'. One string was fixed. Three remained on the same page.
ruleBasis: Same defect class as iw-2026-09-17-3 (applied, MED) - /indices sold the whole page as sold-basis in its banner, subline, meta description and JSON-LD. Same pattern: the fix lands on the instance quoted in the filing and misses the copies.

Recommend copying the subheader's own wording so the page says one thing: 'Pokemon indices sold-basis, Bowman indices ask-basis, re-marked weekly'. While that file is open, grep the whole site for 'sold comps only' and 'sold-comp ... re-mark' rather than fixing the three instances this filing quotes - that is the mistake the Sep 18 push made.

proposals.title: MED — /lionel-messi-cards describes itself as 'with live eBay sold comps' in its meta description, its og:description and its hero, one line above its own basis chip reading 'Ask marks - Aug 31, 2026 (eBay live asks, labeled)'. This is the site's highest-earning page.
evidence:
Live 2026-09-21T12:11:42Z. The identical sentence 'Every key Messi card ranked by ROI, liquidity, and upside, with live eBay sold comps.' appears in , and the hero

.
The next element on the page: '● Ask marks · Aug 31, 2026 (eBay live asks, labeled; house trim)'.
Two of the five ranked rows publish '~$9 asks (base) · house trim, n=10 · Aug 31' and '~$15 asks (base) · house trim, n=10, tight spread · Aug 31'.

The body is correct throughout: asks are labelled asks with trim method and n; trophy figures are attributed sales with house and date ($1.5M MBA-certified PSA 10, $1.1M Goldin private, $212,280 Goldin Jun 2026) under their own scoped stamp 'Trophy-tier results as of Jul 6, 2026.' Nothing in the body overstates anything. The only false claim on the page is the sentence describing the page - and it is the one that goes into the search snippet and the social card.
STATE 2026-09-18: the single largest attributed EPN event in the Sep 4-17 window was an $860 sale off /lionel-messi-cards on 4 clicks. The page also gained an AG link yesterday (7d0f85f).
The sibling AG page already carries the right sentence without being told: /victor-wembanyama-rookie-cards reads 'with live eBay ask marks (labeled as asks - a sold feed comes later)'.
ruleBasis: Same shape as iw-2026-09-17-3 (applied): a surface selling itself as sold-basis over ask-basis data, in banner + meta + structured data.
LANE-RULES Part B: the words overstate the data.
proposals.r6: Not a re-file. audit-2026-09-07-1 names messi only on its watch list for the 63-day Jul 6 trophy lines - that is the stamp, not the basis claim, and the trophy block's own scoped stamp is honest. iw-2026-09-17-3 is /indices. Nothing in the 145 covers this page's description copy.
proposals.suggestedFix: Replace the sentence in all three places with the wemby wording: 'with live eBay ask marks (labeled as asks)'. One string, three instances, no generator involved.
